description:
wrap_zone/4 at paint.ex:218 is a no-op stub with a FIXME. Until it's implemented, all %VZone{} nodes emit no OSC 133 markers. T5 and T6 depend on this ticket.

LineBuf.iolist_rev layout: flush_line/1 prepends [line_iodata, "\n" | existing]. After painting N lines, iolist_rev[0] = last flushed line data, iolist_rev[1] = "\n", iolist_rev[2] = second-to-last, etc. First emitted line is at index 2*(N-1).

Replace the stub with:
  defp wrap_zone(buf, open, close, n) do
    first_idx = 2 * (n - 1)
    iolist_rev =
      buf.iolist_rev
      |> List.update_at(0,         fn l -> [close | List.wrap(l)] end)
      |> List.update_at(first_idx, fn l -> [open  | List.wrap(l)] end)
    %{buf | iolist_rev: iolist_rev}
  end

OSC 133 format unification: existing weld code uses BEL terminator (\e]133;A\a). The VZone paint clause at paint.ex:63 currently builds \e\-terminated sequences with type/id attrs. Update the paint clause to use BEL format: open = "\e]133;A\a", close = "\e]133;B\a\e]133;C\a". The type and id fields stay on the struct for future use.

Tests: Single-line zone: markers on that line. Multi-line zone: open prepended to first line, close appended to last. Empty zone: both markers on one flushed line. Nested zones: no interference.
title: Implement wrap_zone/4 in paint.ex
